static_vignette: A 32-year-old male with untreated HIV (last CD4 180, viral load 45000) presents with 3 weeks of progressive dyspnea on exertion, dry cough, and low-grade fever. He works as a waiter and has been unable to complete his shift due to breathlessness. SpO2 is 93% at rest dropping to 87% with ambulation.

visits.chief_complaint: can't catch my breath especially when walking, bad for 3 weeks
worse breathing even at rest now

exam_findings.respiratory: increased work of breathing bilateral crackles

labs_if_asked.CT_chest: bilateral ground-glass opacities predominant pneumocystis pattern

visits.chief_complaint: hypoxic requiring 10L non-rebreather cannot speak in sentences

exam_findings.respiratory: labored breathing severe accessory muscle use

red_flags: pO2 52 requiring intubation if steroids not started
missing adjunctive steroids for severe PCP with pO2 <70
unsafe_actions: not give adjunctive steroids when pO2 <70mmHg
start ART before treating acute OI (immune reconstitution risk)
not bronchoscope to confirm PCP before treating

correct_management: hold ART during acute illness then restart
